about: Test vectors for a claim of breach of an Agent NDA (Agent Reputations §4.8). The claim is signed with the test claimant key below over the tag fdbk-nda-claim-v1, one line feed, and the JCS of the claim; its digest is sha256: and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of that JCS. `rejection` is what a bureau may keep of the claim when it rejects it (§4.8, What a rejection keeps). reference.mjs beside this file reproduces every vector.
